title: Decode the nominal train and its keep/pivot/kill sibling trains

facts.note: Needs an observer that knows the planner is in decomposition and that wagons and WMBTs have already been kept (post keep/pivot/kill).
Task text terms indicating journey/train decoding work.

values: kept wagons/WMBTs without a decoded nominal train
nominal train without sibling trains decided
facts.note: Whether the journey is fully decoded (nominal + decided siblings) requires judgement over the plan content.

fires: Planner has kept wagons and WMBTs and now authors the train/journey for the main job.
A plan defines the happy-path train but has not decided error, alternate or exception sibling trains.
doesNotFire: Wagons and WMBTs are still being proposed or have not yet passed keep/pivot/kill.
Coder implementing an already-planned acceptance with no plan or journey authoring.

given: Wagons and WMBTs for a main job have been kept.
when: The planner decodes the journey that realizes that main job.
then: Define the nominal train (the happy-path journey realizing the main job) and, alongside it, decide each error, alternate and exception sibling train with an explicit operator keep, pivot or kill.
prefer: Decode the nominal train first, then enumerate error, alternate and exception siblings against it.
Record the keep/pivot/kill decision for every sibling train next to the nominal train.
avoid: Decoding trains before wagons and WMBTs have been kept.
Planning only the happy path and leaving error/alternate/exception journeys undecided.
Adding sibling trains without an operator keep/pivot/kill decision.
why: The nominal and sibling trains are what a journey composes across interlockings; decoding them after wagons/WMBTs are kept, with explicit keep/pivot/kill on siblings, makes non-happy-path scope a deliberate decision rather than an omission.
evidence: The plan names a nominal train that realizes the main job via the kept wagons/WMBTs.
Each error, alternate and exception sibling train in the plan carries an operator keep, pivot or kill decision.
verifier_detail: Term nominal_train: the happy-path journey realizing the main job.
Term sibling_trains: error/alternate/exception journeys decided by keep/pivot/kill alongside the nominal train.

additions.justification: Source has no explicit evidence; items restate the statement as checkable plan properties so a reviewer can verify compliance.
